scripts.build:login: npm run build -w @sanny/i18n && npm run build -w @sanny/styles && npm run build -w @sanny/ui && npm run build -w login
scripts.build:sanny: npm run build -w @sanny/i18n && npm run build -w @sanny/styles && npm run build -w @sanny/ui && npm run build -w sanny
scripts.serve:docs: npm run build -w docs && npm run serve -w docs
scripts.serve:docs-de: npm run build -w docs -- --locale de && npm run serve -w docs
scripts.test:frontend:login: npm run test -w login && npm run build:login
scripts.test:frontend:sanny: npm run test -w sanny && npm run build:sanny
scripts.test:frontend: npm run test:frontend:login && npm run test:frontend:sanny && npm run lint -w @sanny/i18n && npm run lint -w @sanny/styles && npm run lint -w @sanny/ui && npm run test:components
scripts.test:backend: npm run lint:backend && npm run test -w backend
scripts.test:backend:redis: docker compose --project-directory backend/docker --env-file backend/.env run --rm --no-deps --build -e RUN_REAL_REDIS_TESTS=true app node --import=tsx --test src/tests/session-rotation.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:real: npm run test:e2e:real:chromium && npm run test:e2e:real:firefox && npm run test:e2e:real:edge
scripts.test:e2e:mocked: npm run test:e2e:mocked:chromium && npm run test:e2e:mocked:firefox && npm run test:e2e:mocked:edge
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:mocked && npm run test:e2e:real
scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run test:backend && npm run test:backend:redis && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
